description: This source file configures Mitsubishi engine parameters within a firmware project. It sets engine type, trigger, cylinders count, displacement, ignition mode, firing order, trigger offset, cranking parameters, fuel map, sensor configurations, GPIO pin assignments for injection and ignition, display settings, and other engine-specific parameters.

methods.name: void setMitsubishiConfiguration(DECLARE_ENGINE_PARAMETER_SIGNATURE)
methods.description: Initializes and configures Mitsubishi engine parameters, including engine type, triggers, sensors, injection, ignition, and display settings.
